title: House grants fresh 50-year franchise to Cebu Pacific as airline gets another A330 Neo
summary: The franchise approval comes as the Gokongwei-led airline announced that it has taken delivery of its 15th Airbus A330neo aircraft as it continues to modernize its fleet.
